entities.summary: Alfred-Marie-Joseph-Louis Montagne was a French general who commanded the 15th Army Corps during the Battle of France (1940). He was responsible for the defence of Menton during the Italian invasion. He published a recollection of the war, La bataille pour Nice et la Provence, in 1952.
